nl.title: Mixed content (HTTP op HTTPS) oplossen na CyberPanel-SSL
nl.excerpt: Mixed content (HTTP op HTTPS) oplossen na CyberPanel-SSL: gerichte diagnose en fix-stappen van TripleZero iT, met controles.
nl.bodyHtml:
Na HTTPS blijven mixed content-waarschuwingen als CSS/JS/afbeeldingen hard gecodeerd als http:// staan.

Oplossen

  1. Force HTTPS op serverniveau.
  2. Zet site-URL in CMS naar https.
  3. Zoek/vervang http-assets in database (voorzichtig, met backup).
  4. Controleer CDN/externe embeds op https.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem. Vermeld hostname, CyberPanel-URL en wat je precies ziet (foutmelding of screenshot).

Gerelateerd: HTTPS forceren; LiteSpeed Cache.

en.bodyHtml:
This guide covers Resolving mixed content (HTTP on HTTPS) after CyberPanel-SSL. You work in CyberPanel, focusing on resolving, mixed, content — not unrelated side quests in other menus.

Preparation

  • Access to CyberPanel
  • Focus of this article: resolving, mixed, content
  • Note of the current setting/status

Steps

  1. Start in CyberPanel. Before clicking, note the current value for resolving, mixed, content.
  2. Select the correct website in CyberPanel.
  3. Open SSL, DNS, Email, File Manager or Backup — focused on resolving.
  4. Apply the mixed update; purge OLS cache if the site shows stale content.
  5. Check Error Logs if you get 500/white screen after the change.
  6. Isolate: does it work elsewhere (other network, webmail vs client, staging vs live) for resolving, mixed, content?
  7. Correlate with the last change; roll back or fix one cause at a time.

Verify

  • Result for resolving, mixed, content matches “Resolving mixed content (HTTP on HTTPS) after CyberPanel-SSL”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside resolving mixed content
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get resolving, mixed, content right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if resolving, mixed, content touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: CyberPanel, backups, tickets.
